record.question: Cut off wavelength of circular waveguide in TM mode is
record.explanation: Printed page 3 shows the second option as 2*pi*a/(ha)_nm, the circular-waveguide TM cutoff wavelength: the wall condition J_n(h*a)=0 gives lambda_c=2*pi/h. The supplied option text is corrupted and does not reproduce that formula; this selection follows the unambiguous printed option position and needs transcription review. Formula reference: [University of Cincinnati circular-waveguide notes](https://homepages.uc.edu/~ferendam/Courses/EE_611/Waveguide/Circ_WG.pdf).
